name: Maejima Shikanosuke
source:
The main protagonist of Kira Kira. 

After graduating from the academy he proceeded to a university, found a job, and now he lives an honest life. 

He hasn’t done anything band-related since his academy days, and hasn’t even touched his instrument since entering society. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=87]Mangagamer[/url]]
